captures.file: public page, read 10 November 2026 by the curator (not a vault capture)
captures.what_is_new: Web Summit's post 'Important event update', published 10 Nov 2026 19:09 UTC (opens at this address, read by the curator 22:00 UTC). It says the Government of Portugal formally advised that, because of Storm Charles (tidal flooding, severe disruption to public transport, high winds on external structures), Day 2 should not take place, after discussions with the Government, ANEPC and PSP; 'Day 2 (Wednesday, November 11th) will not take place'; Web Summit 'aims to proceed with Day 3 (Thursday, November 12) as planned, following the passing of Storm Charles', will monitor conditions, give further updates as soon as confirmed information is available, and 'communicate directly with those impacted'.

story_candidates.title: Update: Web Summit's Wednesday will not take place; it aims to hold Thursday
story_candidates.angle: An update note for the published Wednesday 11 November guide, from Web Summit's own statement: Day 2 will not take place on the Government's formal advice; Web Summit aims to proceed with Day 3 on Thursday 12 November as planned.
story_candidates.note: Ready as an UPDATE (a note at the top) to wednesday-11-november-going-abroad, not a new article; time-sensitive. Conditions: attribute to Web Summit's post and quote its words; Thursday is an aim, not a confirmation, so say 'aims to' and that it will update as confirmed; do not add what attendees should do beyond what the post says (it says Web Summit will contact those impacted directly); other organisers announce their own side events; re-read the post before publishing. Publication needs approval through reviewer@PrompTugal.vicky.
